description: Canalisations de distribution de gaz de Lorient Agglomération is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Lorient Agglomération. Lignes / canalisations de distribution de gaz par GRDF sur le territoire de Lorient Agglomération: Les informations du tracé du réseau communiquées par GRDF sont fournies à titre indicatif. Les données sont mises à disposition à titre purement indicatif sans garantie quant à leur degré de fiabilité. Coverage: Lorient Agglomération. The publisher named on the listing is Lorient Agglomération. Its keywords include reseaux-transport-denergie, reseaux. The listing shows 3 download or service links in SHAPEFILE, GPKG, CSV. The listing shows 2026-06-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
